hook.name: TweetPadV11UniversalHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a creator fee (1%) and protocol fee (0.5%) from the unspecified side of each swap via afterSwap return delta, with a 10% buy surcharge applied during the first 60 seconds after pool initialization. Accrued fees are held by the hook and claimable by the registered pool creator and a protocol recipient.
